verdict.rationale: Recurring bank payments are a fair question for an open-finance connectivity platform like MX, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no variable recurring payments, standing consents, or recurring debit flows. Instant Account Verification, Tokenized Account Numbers "used for secure ACH money movement," and microdeposits are only building blocks that let a developer set up debits elsewhere; they are not a documented recurring-payment capability.
